name: Interspecies Gene Conversion
description: Convert ENSEMBL gene IDs between different species using BioMart homology mapping. This function converts a list of ENSEMBL gene IDs from one species to their homologous counterparts in another specie
detailed_description: Convert ENSEMBL gene IDs between different species using BioMart homology mapping. This function converts a list of ENSEMBL gene IDs from one species to their homologous counterparts in another species using the Ensembl BioMart database. The conversion is based on one-to-one ortholog mappings between species.
when_to_use: When you need interspecies gene conversion analysis

parameters.gene_list: [Required] List of ENSEMBL gene IDs to convert (e.g., ['ENSG00000007372', 'ENSG00000181449']) (list[str])
parameters.source_species: [Required] Source species name. Supported species: human, mouse, rat, zebrafish, fly, drosophila, worm, yeast, chicken, pig, cow, dog, macaque (str)
parameters.target_species: [Required] Target species name. Same supported species as source_species (str)
